about: The campaign's MESSAGES (the M of POEMS): every phrase the page and the mock-ups share, and the mock-ups' own. Change a phrase here and rebuild: the page (`npm run build`) and all four mock-ups (`npm run build:mockups`) carry it. Public. The offer is not here: it is data/offers.json. `event_line` is a list of parts, joined with a middle dot. In `from_price`, {price} is replaced with the lowest price per meal of the plans the page shows (data/plans.json). `handoff` is the cart hand-off's progress screen on the store's order page (SPEC-rung2-progress-and-checkout.md § 2), inlined by `npm run build:storefront` (never by `npm run build`): its title, the step line after each meal is added ({meal} the meal as its card shows it, {n} the meals added so far, {total} the plan's meals), and the line at the store's CHECKOUT, and `stopped` the line when the cart could not be filled and the store's own order page is next (SPEC-rung2-fill-c § 1.6; a placeholder for the Advisor's copy review). `chefs_choice` is this week's Chef's Choice on the plan page's result card (SPEC-chefs-choice.md § 3), read by `npm run build` only when a week in data/picks/ is open (without one the page does not change): `open` the button that opens the list, `heading` the list's heading ({week} the week the meals are for, Monday to Sunday after the delivery Sunday, since SPEC-plan-page-refinement § 8 item 6: "October 5–11", across a month "September 28 – October 4"), `meal_qty` a meal chosen more than once ({meal} its name, {n} how many), `note` the line under the list, `checkout` the link to the store's checkout, `own` the plain link to the plan's order page. The build refuses a missing phrase or placeholder. ⚠ Its words are PLACEHOLDERS for the Advisor's copy review (`status`); since SPEC-plan-page-refinement.md the card no longer shows `open` (the list is always open) or `note` (it may return reworded), both kept here. `plan_page` is the plan page's own words since SPEC-plan-page-refinement.md § 2, read by `npm run build`: `counts` the meals question's two buttons by meals a week (`*or*` / `*and*`: a word between asterisks is emphasised), `per_week` the unit under each button's numeral (§ 8 item 4), `total_unit` and `per_meal_unit` the result's two figures' units (§ 8 item 5), `prices_as_of` the footnote ({date} data/plans.json's `read_on`; ⚠ a placeholder until the Owner or legal confirm it). The page no longer shows `headline`, `subhead` or `event_line` (the hero is the Advisor's rewrite); the mock-ups still do. The build refuses a missing phrase or placeholder.
